about_the_game:
"Leila's Fantasy Music Pack" is a collection of 13 loopable tracks.
 Inspired by classic fantasy games, this pack offers music that captures a wide range of moods—perfect for everything from peaceful village scenes to epic battles.

The tracks are also available in different file extensions.

 

Tracklist (all in m4a and ogg format):

1 - Veil of the Hidden Realm

2 - Echoes of the Elven Song

3 - Enchanted Forest

4 - The Crystal Kingdom

5 - Wings of the Silver Dragon

6 - Through the Gates of Avalon

7 - Dancing With the Phoenix

8 - The Dragon's Lair

9 - The Secret Garden of the Stars

10 - Into the Dreamscape

11 - Whispers of the Void

12 - The Forgotten Spellbook

13 - Among the Twilight Stars

 

--------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
